unitTitle: Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: for/since/just/yet/already davomi, Present Perfect Simple va Continuous mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 7-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (37-bet, PDF 36). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
6-mashq davomi: 5 My parents have been living here since/for 1950. 6 Janet hasn't called me back yet/already. 7 Have they returned from their trip yet/already? 8 She hasn't seen her cousin for/just two years. 9 Mrs Topper has been working in the town library since/yet 1971. 10 They have just/for returned from their trip. 11 I have already/yet been to the post office. 12 Vanessa has been sleeping just/for two hours.
'Present Perfect Simple and Continuous':
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect simple or present perfect continuous.' 1 A: Where's Peter? B: He ...... (just/leave) for work. 2 A: Why are you tired? B: I ...... (play) football. 3 A: Is Paul studying in his room? B: Yes, he ...... (study) since 4:00. 4 A: How is Jim? B: I don't know. I ...... (not/speak) to him since Monday. 5 A: Let's go out to eat tonight. B: How about tomorrow night? I ...... (already/cook) dinner. 6 A: I'm going to the cinema. B: Again! You ...... (see) three films this week! 7 A: Has Diana lost weight? B: Yes, she ...... (exercise) for 6 months. 8 A: Does Tom work at MLT Limited? B: Yes, he ...... (work) at that company for ten years. 9 A: Do John and Andy live in Spain? B: Yes, they ...... (live) in Spain since 1987. 10 A: Have you finished the book that I lent you? B: No, I ...... (finish) it yet.

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'What have these people been doing? Make sentences using an appropriate verb in the present perfect continuous, as in the example.' SURATLAR: 1 Richard stol ustida kitob bilan - Richard started studying for tomorrow's exam four hours ago. He is still studying. → Richard has been studying for four hours. 2 Sandra molbert oldida rasm chizyapti - Sandra began painting the picture a month ago. She hasn't finished it yet. 3 Tom aeroportda kutib o'tiribdi - Tom went to the airport at 8:00. It is now 10:00 and he is still waiting for his flight. 4 bolalar bog'da o'ynashyapti - James and Amy went outside to play with their friends an hour ago. They haven't come home yet. 5 mashina yo'lda (g'ozlar o'tyapti) - The Moores set off for their trip at 7:00. It is 11:00 and they are still travelling.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '37'.

exercises.instructionEn: What have these people been doing? Make sentences using an appropriate verb in the present perfect continuous, as in the example. 1 Richard started studying for tomorrow's exam four hours ago. He is still studying. → Richard has been studying for four hours. 2 Sandra began painting the picture a month ago. She hasn't finished it yet. 3 Tom went to the airport at 8:00. It is now 10:00 and he is still waiting for his flight. 4 James and Amy went outside to play with their friends an hour ago. They haven't come home yet. 5 The Moores set off for their trip at 7:00. It is 11:00 and they are still travelling.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar nima qilib kelishyapti? Present perfect continuous da mos fe'l bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 Richard to'rt soat oldin ertangi imtihonga tayyorlana boshladi. U hali o'qiyapti. → Richard to'rt soatdan beri o'qiyapti. 2 Sandra bir oy oldin rasm chiza boshladi. Hali tugatmagan. 3 Tom soat 8 da aeroportga bordi. Hozir 10 va u hali reysini kutyapti. 4 Jeyms va Emi bir soat oldin do'stlari bilan o'ynagani chiqishdi. Hali uyga qaytishmagan. 5 Murlar soat 7 da sayohatga chiqishdi. Hozir 11 va ular hali yo'lda.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS +
  FOR + MUDDAT.

  Boshlangan vaqt + hozir hali
  davom → has/have been + V-ing +
  for ...

  1 studying for four hours
  2 painting for a month
  3 waiting for two hours (8 → 10)
  4 playing for an hour
  5 travelling for four hours
    (7 → 11)


⚠ 'TO SET OFF':

  = yo'lga chiqmoq.

patterns.formula: KIM + has / have + just / already + V3 — KIM + hasn't / haven't + V3 + yet
patterns.exampleEn: He has just left for work. I haven't finished it yet.
patterns.exampleUz: U endigina ishga ketdi. Hali tugatmadim.

patterns.formula: KIM + has / have been + V-ing + for / since ...
patterns.exampleEn: He has been studying since 4:00. She has been exercising for 6 months.
patterns.exampleUz: U soat 4 dan beri o'qiyapti. U 6 oydan beri mashq qilyapti.

patterns.formula: Why are you tired? — I have been + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: Why are you tired? — I have been playing football.
